cli.description: Browse, publish and initialize GitHub Spec Kit projects in the browser
cli.serve: Start the local viewer for a Spec Kit project (default command)
cli.build: Build the project documents into a static website
cli.init: Initialize a new Spec Kit project (delegates to the official specify CLI)
opt.port: Port to listen on (auto-increments when busy)
opt.title: Site title
opt.script: Script type: sh, ps or py
opt.yes: Use defaults for every option not given (does not confirm overwrites)
opt.force: Skip the overwrite confirmation (the file list is still printed)
opt.dryRun: Only print the files that would be created/overwritten
opt.initOpen: Start the viewer after a successful init
err.dirMissing: Directory not found or not a directory: {dir}
serve.notSpecKit: No Spec Kit project detected in {dir}. The page offers an init wizard.
serve.noPort: Could not find a free port starting at {port}.
serve.watchFailed: File watching failed: {msg}. Live reload is disabled.
build.notSpecKit: {dir} is not a Spec Kit project (no .specify/ directory). Run `speckit-web init` first.
build.refuseClean: Refusing to clear {out}: it exists and was not created by speckit-web (no .speckit-web-build marker).
build.refuseInside: Refusing to write the site into {out}: it is inside specs/ or .specify/.
build.pagesHint: Publish to GitHub Pages: copy examples/github-pages.yml into .github/workflows/ of your project.
init.prereqMissing: Neither the Spec Kit CLI (specify) nor uvx was found.
init.askTarget: Where should the project be created?
init.planHeader: {create} to create, {overwrite} to overwrite, {unchanged} unchanged in {target}
init.confirmOverwrite: The target is not empty. Continue and write these files?
init.needForce: The target is not empty; re-run with --force to write these files.
init.done: Initialized a Spec Kit project in {target} (specify {version}, {integration}, {script})
init.next.constitution: Run /speckit-constitution in your AI agent to set project principles
init.next.specify: Run /speckit-specify <description> to write the first spec
init.next.view: Run npx speckit-web to browse the documents
init.leftovers: Could not roll back these files, please check them manually:
init.error.nameSeparator: Use a child directory name without path separators.
init.error.nameInvalid: The directory name contains invalid characters.
init.error.targetInvalid: Choose the current directory or a new child directory.
init.error.integrationInvalid: The assistant key contains invalid characters.
init.error.targetUnsafe: The target path is outside the allowed directory or contains a symbolic link.
init.error.targetFile: The target already exists as a file.
init.error.planChanged: The target changed after preview. Generate a new preview before applying.
